dashboard.label: CMDB Inventory
dashboard.description: Current endpoint inventory, monitoring policy, identity, and collector-confirmed state. The default 24-hour window keeps the view responsive; expand it deliberately when older inventory history is needed.

search.query: | inputlookup ping_monitor_settings_lookup | search _key="global" | head 1 | append [| makeresults | eval index="ping", sourcetype="ping_monitor"] | head 1 | eval pm_index=if(isnull(index) OR index=="", "ping", index) | eval pm_sourcetype=if(isnull(sourcetype) OR sourcetype=="", "ping_monitor", sourcetype)
`ping_cmdb_inventory($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | where isnotnull(group) AND group!="" | stats count by group | fields group | sort group

html.p: This view contains actively managed monitoring inventory and collector-confirmed health. Subnet scan evidence—including discovered-only IPs and DNS enrichment—is available in Discovery Inventory.

search.query: `ping_cmdb_inventory($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | where monitoring_status="Active" | stats count AS active
`ping_cmdb_inventory($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | where monitoring_status="Maintenance" | stats count AS maintenance
`ping_cmdb_inventory($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | where monitoring_status="Paused" | stats count AS paused

`ping_cmdb_inventory($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | search (monitoring_status="$monitoring_filter$" OR "$monitoring_filter$"="*") | search (group="$group_filter$" OR "$group_filter$"="*") | search endpoint_key="*$inventory_search$*" OR hostname="*$inventory_search$*" OR fqdn="*$inventory_search$*" OR target_ip="*$inventory_search$*" OR vendor="*$inventory_search$*" OR device="*$inventory_search$*" | eval fqdn=coalesce(fqdn, "Not resolved"), group=coalesce(group, "Unassigned"), maintenance_reason=coalesce(maintenance_reason, ""), alerting_reason=coalesce(alerting_reason, ""), asset_id=coalesce(asset_id, ""), classification_source=coalesce(classification_source, "manual/legacy") | table endpoint_key, asset_id, hostname, fqdn, target_ip, device_mode, monitoring_status, alerting_status, alerting_reason, dynamic_address, inventory_state, observation_status, signal_quality, group, entitytype, device, vendor, classification_source, last_latency_ms, last_packet_loss_pct, maintenance_until, maintenance_reason, first_seen_human, last_seen_human | rename endpoint_key AS "Endpoint ID", asset_id AS "Asset ID", hostname AS "Hostname", fqdn AS "FQDN", target_ip AS "IP Address", device_mode AS "Mode", monitoring_status AS "Monitoring", alerting_status AS "Alerting", alerting_reason AS "Alerting Reason", dynamic_address AS "Dynamic Address", inventory_state AS "Current State", observation_status AS "Observation", signal_quality AS "Signal Quality", group AS "Group", entitytype AS "Entity Type", device AS "Device", vendor AS "Vendor", classification_source AS "Classification Source", last_latency_ms AS "Last Latency (ms)", last_packet_loss_pct AS "Last Packet Loss %", maintenance_until AS "Maintenance Until", maintenance_reason AS "Maintenance Reason", first_seen_human AS "First Seen in Window", last_seen_human AS "Last Seen" | sort "Monitoring", "Current State", "Hostname"
`ping_cmdb_inventory($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | eval fqdn_coverage=if(isnotnull(fqdn) AND fqdn!="", "FQDN present", "FQDN missing") | stats count by fqdn_coverage
